text:
Tom W: Heads-up  I'm in AMS for a conf next week (De Pijp area). Any must-try local eats? Looking for one memorable dinner (rijsttafel?) and a chill breakfast spot that does vegan pancakes.
Eef: Yes to rijsttafel  try Moeders for Dutch comfort? but for proper Indonesian rijsttafel go to 'Sampurna' or 'Blue Toko' in Oud-West. book ahead for groups.
Hannah: For vegan pancakes go to 'Pancakes & More' (they have a solid buckwheat vegan stack) or 'Veggie Sweets'  both walkable if you're near De Pijp.
Luis: Coffee pro-tip: 'Bocca' near city center for espresso, or 'Lot Sixty One' in De Pijp for filter. both open early.
Tom W: Any late-night snacks after the conference socials? I'm curious about stroopwafel spots or bitterballen.
Eef: Stroopwafels are everywhere but 'Van Wonderen' has fancy ones and good toppings. Bitterballen: 'Café de Klos' does great ones with mustard.
Hannah: If you want something really local and cheap, try the FEBO automats  quick, nostalgic.
Luis: If you need GF options, mention it at the rijsttafel  many places can swap rice/no gluten soy. call in advance.
Tom W: Great. Any recs on getting from Schiphol to De Pijp with luggage? train vs taxi?
Eef: Train to Amsterdam Centraal + tram 24 to De Pijp is easy. With heavy luggage, grab a taxi from arrivals  about 25-35 euros.
Hannah: Also consider the NS luggage lockers if you want a quick drop before check-in.
TravelBot: Saved travel notes: "AMS De Pijp eats: Sampurna / Blue Toko (rijsttafel), Pancakes & More / Veggie Sweets (vegan pancakes), Lot Sixty One / Bocca (coffee), Van Wonderen (stroopwafel), Café de Klos (bitterballen)." Run `redwood-travel help ams` for hours and booking links.
Tom W: Sweet  planning Sampurna Fri 8pm for the team. Anyone want to join? react with :raised_hand: or say 'I'll pass'.
Eef: :raised_hand: count me in.
Hannah: I'll pass (evening sessions clash)
Luis: :raised_hand: I'll bring my appetite.
